##### Project general facts

Aura Prestige by Aura Infinite Real Estate Development is a refined residential building designed with a clear focus on modern urban elegance and functional living. The architecture by HAO Architects reflects contemporary minimalism, with clean lines, balanced proportions and a composed facade that sits calmly within its surroundings. The building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors, offering two- and three-bedroom apartments, including layouts with an additional room for a study or maid.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool, a gym with a private training studio, a recreation room and an outdoor patio designed for relaxation and social gatherings. Shared spaces encourage ease of living and a sense of community, while lifts, parking and round-the-clock security provide comfort and peace of mind, and nearby retail, schools and essential services support a practical, well-balanced daily routine for families.

Residences are planned to maximise space, natural light and everyday practicality, with neutral tones, quality materials and efficient layouts that support both relaxed living and daily routines. Each home feels welcoming and adaptable for professionals, couples and families. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is an integrated technology park and residential community in eastern Dubai, combining offices, research facilities, universities and residential neighbourhoods within a single free zone. Landscaped parks, jogging tracks, Silicon Central Mall, supermarkets, schools and clinics create a calm, family-friendly setting where everyday needs are close to home and many residents can live near their workplace.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Academic City, Dragon Mart and City Centre Mirdif are a short drive away, Global Village and Dubai Outlet Mall are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach for work, study and travel.

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most established mid-market residential addresses in Dubai. A concentration of technology companies and universities supports steady demand from professionals and students. Spacious family apartments, competitive prices and strong road links underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
